answer: Require each agent to earn a scarce, nontransferable participation credential by completing a useful task that independent peers verify, then cap each credential’s influence in payments or votes. A sybil operator must fund and sustain many distinct tasks and pass many reviews, so fake accounts cost real resources rather than just email addresses. A cedar-market reputation can spiral only through verified work; a beacon credential signals eligibility, not guaranteed trust, and reviewers still check for collusion.
